page.overview:
Who is Abin Sur?

The Abin Sur is a judge of worlds. His task was to travel to planets targeted by Mogo, the Blackstar World, and select Ain, or initiates, into the levels of light. As a community was a world in miniature, he would chose a random settlement and evaluate the people within.

He would select three from the people to be Ain: one who showed restraint would be Ain Rao, one who sought understanding would be Ain Aur, and one who showed correct action would be Air Sur.

He would take all the people inside his starship, The Green Lantern, and from there into the presence of OA. The three chosen Ain would be given the power of their level of light.

On a day seemingly like any other Abin Sur and the Green Lantern appeared in the sky over Evergreen, Nevada and surrounded the town with a force field. He beamed down to the surface and the entire town turned out to see what was happening. Abin Sur announced that he existed at the "Green Level of Light" and ordered the people of Evergreen to "be without fear". Sheriff Guy Gardner approached Abin Sur and said that he was the authority in Evergreen. Abin Sur summoned green energy in his hand and levelled it at Guy, saying that judgement would commence. Guy and his deputies interpreted this as a threat and drew their weapons, while Abin Sur calmly told Guy that he did not exist in the "Spectrum of Light" and once again instructed him to be without fear. Jo Mullein was able to convince Guy not to escalate and the sheriffs stood down. Guy asked Abin Sur to tell them what he wanted, but Abin Sur seemingly obliterated Guy with a blast, declaring that he had been judged. In reality, Guy had been sent into the Lantern. For showing restraint in the face of perceived danger, Guy was deemed worthy of being named the Air Rao, and given the power of the Red Flame. Guy's deputies opened fire on Abin Sur but he blocked their bullets with a force field, decapitated one with his bare hands and cut the other's hand off. Hal Jordan ran up, grabbed the fallen deputy's gun and pointed it at Abin Sur. Abin Sur showed no fear of this and told Hal that his judgment was in progress, even addressing Hal by name. John Stewart got in between them and told Hal to lower the gun, saying that Abin Sur would just kill him too if he tried to shoot him; and Hal reluctantly did so. Abin Sur told John to be without fear, also addressing him by name, and then flew back up to the Lantern. John Stewart discovered that anything made of gold, or even gold-coloured, could pass through the dome around the town and even momentarily open a hole in it. Abin Sur flew down to where John was standing on the boundary and sent him into the Green Lantern, stating that he had been judged. From the perspective of the others, he appeared to have obliterated John with a blast of energy. For seeking knowledge, John was chosen to be the Ain Aur and bear the Gold Flame.
